name: Level design
whatItIs: Seeded room-and-corridor dungeons with start and stairs placement (stairs in the room farthest by walking distance).
gotchas: Small maps can fail to place minRooms; the generator throws instead of returning a broken level.
Godot port: Array.sort_custom is not stable but JS sort is; rooms are ordered with a stable insertion sort so tied room centres keep the same order.
